title: Two Different Siblings
text:
My friend Ana is very kind. She helps her friends with homework. She is also funny, and she makes everybody laugh. Ana is not shy at all.

My brother Leo is different. He is quiet and very patient. He likes to read books alone. Leo is also honest, so he always tells the truth.

questions.text: What does Ana do for her friends?
What does Leo like to do?
What can we infer about Ana?
options: She feels comfortable around other people
She is afraid of other people

vocabulary.definition: friendly and helpful to other people
able to wait calmly without getting angry
nervous or quiet around other people

paragraph_translations: Minha amiga Ana é muito gentil. Ela ajuda as amigas com a lição de casa. Ela também é engraçada e faz todo mundo rir. Ana não é tímida nem um pouco.
Meu irmão Leo é diferente. Ele é quieto e muito paciente. Ele gosta de ler livros sozinho. Leo também é honesto, então ele sempre diz a verdade.
